fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-margin-guard-enabled", "false") == "true" && context.Request.Method != "OPTIONS" && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-margin-guard-url", "").Trim().Length > 0)">
            <set-variable name="mgCustomerId" value="@{
                if (context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-customer-id")) {
                    return (Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-customer-id"]) ?? "").Trim();
                }
                var payload = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-jwt-payload", null) as JObject;
                var fromJwt = payload == null ? null
                    : (payload["customer_id"]?.ToString() ?? payload["sub"]?.ToString());
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fromJwt)) return fromJwt;
                return context.Subscription != null ? context.Subscription.Id : "";
            }" />
            

            
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mgCustomerId", "") != "")">

                    
                    
                    <set-variable name="mgCall" value="@{
                        var c = context.Variables.ContainsKey("mgCached") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["mgCached"]) : "";
                        if (c == null || c.Length == 0) { return "true"; }
                        if (!c.StartsWith("F:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return "false"; }
                        if (!System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(c, "^F:[0-9]{1,5}$")) { return "true"; }
                        var lim = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["mgLimits"]).Split(',');
                        return Convert.ToInt32(c.Substring(2)) < Convert.ToInt32(lim[1]) ? "true" : "false";
                    }" />
                    
                        
                            
                                @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-margin-guard-url", "").Trim().TrimEnd('/') + "/api/v1/margin-guard/quick-check?scopeType=CUSTOMER&scopeId=" + Uri.EscapeDataString((string)context.Variables["mgCustomerId"]))
                                GET
                                
                                    application/json
                                
                                
                                    @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-api-key") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-api-key"]) : "{{aforo-api-key}}")
                                
                            
                        
                    
                    <set-variable name="mgAnswer" value="@{
                        if (Convert.ToString(context.Variables["mgCall"]) != "true") { return ""; }
                        try {
                            var r = context.Variables.ContainsKey("mgResponse") ? (IResponse)context.Variables["mgResponse"] : null;
                            if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return "UNAVAILABLE"; }
                            var text = r.Body.As();
                            JObject.Parse(text);
                            return text;
                        } catch { return "UNAVAILABLE"; }
                    }" />
                    
                    
                        
                            
                        
                    
                    
                    
                    

                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                                
                                
                                    application/json
                                
                                
                                    blocked
                                
                                
                                    L3
                                
                                
                                    @{
                                        var s = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["mgLimits"]).Split(',')[0];
                                        return s == "0" ? "1" : s;
                                    }
                                
                                @{
                                    var s = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["mgLimits"]).Split(',')[0];
                                    var m = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["mgMessage"]);
                                    return new JObject(
                                        new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                            new JProperty("code", "SERVICE_RESTRICTED_MARGIN"),
                                            new JProperty("message", string.IsNullOrEmpty(m) ? "Service restricted due to margin constraints. Contact support." : m),
                                            new JProperty("retryAfterSeconds", s == "0" ? 1 : Convert.ToInt32(s)),
                                            new JProperty("supportUrl", "/portal/support")
                                        ))
                                    ).ToString();
                                }
                            
                        

                        
                        
                            
                                
                                
                                    application/json
                                
                                
                                    throttled
                                
                                
                                    L2
                                
                                
                                    1
                                
                                {"error":{"code":"RATE_LIMITED_MARGIN","message":"Rate limited due to margin constraints. Please retry.","retryAfterSeconds":1,"dashboardUrl":"/portal/cost-explorer"}}
                            
                        

                        
                        
                            
                                margin-low
